title: UzEngine Mesh
description: UzEngine mesh file (.uzmesh) — 3D mesh definition with vertex layout, submeshes, material references, bounding volumes, and LOD chain. The JSON header describes structure; binary vertex/index data is stored in the companion .uzpak or loose binary.

name.description: Mesh display name for editor and debug UI.

vertex_layout.description: Ordered list of vertex attributes. Defines the per-vertex data layout in the binary buffer.

semantic.description: Vertex attribute semantic. Maps to HLSL input semantics (POSITION, NORMAL, etc.).

format.description: Data format per vertex. float3 = 12 bytes, unorm8x4 = 4 bytes (packed color), uint16x4 = 8 bytes (joint indices).

submeshes.description: List of submeshes (draw calls). Each submesh has its own material and index range.

name.description: Submesh name (often from the source DCC tool).

material.description: Path to default material asset (.uzmaterial). Can be overridden per-instance in .uzscene.

index_offset.description: Starting index in the index buffer for this submesh.

index_count.description: Number of indices to draw for this submesh.

vertex_offset.description: Base vertex offset added to each index.

index_format.description: Index buffer element size. uint16 saves memory for meshes with < 65536 vertices.

vertex_count.description: Total number of vertices in the vertex buffer.

index_count.description: Total number of indices in the index buffer.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounding box in local space. Used for frustum culling and LOD selection.

lods.description: Level-of-detail chain. LOD 0 is the highest detail. Each LOD specifies a screen-size threshold and its own submesh/vertex data.

screen_size.description: Minimum screen coverage ratio [0..1] for this LOD to be used. LOD 0 typically = 1.0.

data_offset.description: Byte offset into the binary data blob for this LOD's vertex/index data.

skeleton.description: Path to the skeleton asset (.uzskeleton) if this is a skinned mesh.

morph_targets.description: Named morph targets (blend shapes) for facial animation or deformation.

data_offset.description: Byte offset into binary blob for delta position/normal data.

import_settings.description: Settings used when importing this mesh from source (glTF/FBX). Preserved for reimport.

generate_lods.description: Auto-generate LOD chain via meshoptimizer simplification.
